title: ArduPilot EKF3 source-set switch under GPS denial
summary: Flies ArduCopter SITL on GPS, switches EKF3 to an external-nav source set (SITL vicon) with MAV_CMD_SET_EKF_SOURCE_SET, cuts simulated GPS, flies a 15 m leg, then restores it. A --no-switch contrast run shows the EKF losing position and the EKF failsafe landing the copter. EKF_STATUS_REPORT, GPS fix and local position are logged throughout; the flag decoder is stdlib with unit tests.
verified: Ran on 2026-11-06 against ArduCopter Copter-4.6.3 SITL in Docker (samples/sitl-docker, linux/arm64) with pymavlink 2.4.50 on python3.12: source switch accepted, EKF kept POS_HORIZ_ABS with GPS fix_type 1 for 30 s and flew the 15 m leg; --no-switch lost position after ~6 s and triggered 'EKF Failsafe: changed to LAND Mode'. Output in README. ekf_flags.py tests (6) pass on python3.14.7. --switch-via rc not run.
first_command: python3 source_switch.py --connect tcp:127.0.0.1:5762 --setup && python3 source_switch.py --connect tcp:127.0.0.1:5762
